svg.text: Hyperdrive vs the baseline, same model and hardware
Gray = the stock recipe, or the next full-quality entry for Qwen. Blue = Hyperdrive.
Stock model-card recipe (best, max 32 users, cache-assisted): 1,256
Nemotron Super VL · 1x DGX Spark · 8 users, 1K/1K
Nemotron Bolt · 1x DGX Spark · Flare · voice turn, lower is better
Stock Flare recipe: 0.219 s to first token
Pushed even further on B300: 7,264 tok/s per GPU (7,053 sustained), 5.8x the stock B200 recipe.
